You've worked hard to get where you are today. You want your next step to be the right one. And now you're ready to use your unique skills, talents and personality to achieve great things.
 At LINKSOFT , our goal is to mentor future industry leaders and encourage our professionals to grow and achieve their maximum potential. With LINKSOFT you will have the opportunity to take initiative, own your ideas, and work alongside a team of professionals that are always focused on delivering excellence, but never forget to have fun along the way. If that sounds like a great place to work, you might just be a great fit.
 The ideal candidate will be familiar with the full software design life cycle. They should have experience in designing, coding, testing and consistently managing applications.
 They should be comfortable coding in a number of languages and have an ability to test code in order to maintain high-quality code.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, code, test and manage various applications,
Collaborate with engineering team and product team to establish best products,
Follow outlined standards of quality related to code and systems,
Develop automated tests and conduct performance tuning.
 Qualifications: 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field, required,
Programming experience using C#,
Experience with JavaScript,
Experience with object oriented design and programming skills,
Experience with XML,
Experience developing and maintaining .NET web applications,
Experience developing and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server Stored Procedures, Tables, Views, etc.
 Nice to have: MS Dynamics 365 CRM knowledge. 
 Reasons for being our colleague: 
Personalized benefits package;
The work environment is friendly and professional;
Continuous personal and professional development;
The work schedule is flexible with the ability to work remotely;
Engagement activities;
Trainings, Certifications;
Private medical subscription;
Birthday bonus;
Bookster subscription;
Fruits, coffee and refreshments at your discretion at the office;
Lensa discounts.
 LINKSOFT is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values integrity and ambition, proactivity and customer focus.
 For more information, visit www.linksoft.com .
